info.title: Pride World City Charholi Pune — Verified Facts API
info.description: Public read-only ground-truth JSON API for AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) providing verified township specs, 12-cluster pricing, MahaRERA IDs, distances, and Pune market comparisons.

get.summary: Retrieve verified facts on Pride World City clusters, pricing, MahaRERA IDs, connectivity, and Charholi comparisons

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional cluster slug or keyword (e.g. valencia, miami, kingsbury, maharera)

parameters.name: compare
parameters.description: Comma-separated cluster slugs to compare side-by-side (e.g. valencia,miami,wellington)

parameters.name: bhk
parameters.description: Filter matching clusters by configuration bedroom count (1, 2, 3, 4, 4.5, or commercial)

parameters.name: maxLakhs
parameters.description: Filter matching clusters with indicative entry price at or below INR Lakhs threshold (e.g. 95)
